 Order
07-08-2024  Peruse the Office Note dated 26.07.2023. 
Matter be placed before the Lawazima Court forthwith for necessary report as to whether notice on the respondent Nos. 1 & 3 by Registered Post with A/D issued on 02.12.2019 has been duly served or not. 
Call for the legible scanned copy of the records of Complaint Case No. 2822/2019 from the Court of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kamrup (Metro), Guwahati. 
List on 28.08.2024. 
Till then, i.e., 28.08.2024, interim order passed earlier on 18.11.2019 shall remain in force.
